en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Shinagawa City Senior Citizens' Housing Ordinance
en.summary: The current monthly fee for Atsumi Mansion is ¥72,000. This bill changes it to ¥78,000 per month, effective April 1, 2026.

en.why: The ward says the fee for Atsumi Mansion needs to be revised.
